title: kv-cache: improved memory management and spillover eviction policy to reduce fragmentation and paging
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: KV cache fragmentation and aggressive paging/spillover were causing increased tail latency and inefficient GPU memory utilization under mixed-length conversational workloads. This change introduces a new memory management layer and eviction policy tuned for fragmentation reduction, adaptive paging thresholds, and prioritized spillover/compaction to minimize costly page faults. Summary of changes: 1) Introduce compactable segments for KV allocations that allow lightweight in-place defragmentation without full KV rebuild. 2) Add adaptive paging thresholds that increase spillover tolerance for short-lived contexts and tighten thresholds for long KV lifetimes. 3) Implement eviction priority buckets (hot/warm/cold) based on recent K/V access recency + token-length-weighted cost model. 4) Add async background compaction that runs opportunistically when GPU utilization < 30% and freeable-fragments > 8MB. 5) New telemetry and tracing hooks for fragmentation, page-faults, spillover events, and compaction runs. Backwards compatibility: defaults are conservative and preserve existing cache behavior unless explicitly enabled by node config or rollout feature flag. Rollout plan: gated rollout behind feature flag "kv_memory_v2" with Canary on 10% of serving nodes, monitor fragmentation metrics, tail latency, and page-fault rate for 72h before 50%->100% expansion. Benchmarks: internal perf runs on multi-length chat workload show 12-18% reduction in P99 token latency under medium memory pressure and up to 25% reduction in total page-faults. Testing: unit tests for allocation/eviction logic, integration tests with continuous-batching harness, and benchmark smoke in CI. Related: ENG-1483 (eviction policy redesign), ENG-1499 (compaction background worker). Follow-ups: automatic tuning for adaptive thresholds and expose per-tenant settings in Redwood Console. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests - [x] Perf benchmarks - [x] Telemetry added

Ava Chen (author): Added the alternating-length integration test (tests/kv_cache/test_adaptive_paging_integration.cc) and implemented a cooldown window for the compactor with a configurable cap. Pushed new commit c3a8f22 -> d4f7b66.
Priya Nair: Can we expose a per-node metric for fragmentable_bytes and make it available in the Console per-route dashboard? This will help SRE triage.

Omar Patel: Minor nit: prefer explicit unit in config YAML (MB) and more descriptive flag name. Otherwise approve.
Marcus Valdez: approving after the integration test and safety cap changes. Approve.
release_notes: Improved KV cache memory management and eviction policy: reduced fragmentation via compactable segments and background compaction, adaptive paging thresholds to lower page-faults under mixed workloads, and prioritized eviction buckets to reduce tail latency. Rollout behind feature flag kv_memory_v2; monitor fragmentation and page-fault metrics.
